newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - June 30.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - June 30.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 33.47 points to close at 7,687.72 on investors' growing expectations that the Federal Reserve will not raise interest rates.

* The Indonesian government will continue its economic deregulation drive, but it wants to make sure the policy will further narrow the gap between rich and poor, Bisnis Indonesia newspaper quoted National Planning Minister Ginandjar Kartasasmita as saying.
* On Friday, the Jakarta Composite Index was up 7.42 points, or 1.05 percent, to 716.83 points. On the week, the index rose 4.6 points, or 0.65 percent.
* On Monday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,431.25/31.75 at 0145 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,430.50/31.50.
* Lippo Securities on reports it has revised up its net forecast to 121.6 billion rupiah from its previous 95.7 billion rupiah.
* Poultry firm Cipendawa on reports of a proposed 80 billion rupiah rights issue.
* Cigarette maker Sampoerna on reports it is in talks to form an alliance with Indonesia's largest conglomerate the Salim Group.
* Blue chip toll-road operator Citra Marga Nusaphala Persada and transportation firm Steady Safe after Steady Safe reportedly said it will buy an 11.01 percent stake in Citra Marga.
